title: A better view of the table
changes: New camera controls: enter Move camera mode to orbit with one finger and pinch or pan with two. Focus balls, Whole table, and zoom buttons make adjusting the view easier.
Optional automatic framing follows the remaining balls after a shot settles. Enabled by default on mobile, disabled on desktop; manual camera movement takes priority.
Click the version badge to read this release history.
Warmer lighting, shadows, detailed felt and wood, improved cushions and pockets, table legs, and a visible ball return.
Improved cue geometry and assisted elevation, collision handling, and rolling behavior. Optional fast-forward for fine movements.
Clearer player cards and adaptive instructions, immediate pocket indicators, configurable rail sights and cue ball markings, and a spin reset button.
Bar 8-Ball placement guidance and persistent tutorial dismissal. Browser tests run separately from required deployment checks.
